page: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Fadsv7 server family. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, offering 3780 GB of capacity with Premium Storage capability, while the virtualization layer is managed via Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark data indicates strong computational and memory performance. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression both rank in the top tier (top 10%). Multi-core CPU performance and uncached memory bandwidth write speeds fall within the top 25% tier. In database-specific testing, the server achieves top-tier status (top 10%) in PassMark database operations, alongside a strong rating for Redis SET operations at 89.24 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning workloads, the processor delivers top-tier prompt processing speeds of 4183.35 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F32ads_v7 provides a balanced resource profile by combining dedicated high-frequency AMD EPYC cores with substantial local storage capacity, reducing the need for external block storage attachments for data-intensive tasks. This hardware configuration is suited for database hosting, web serving, and moderate-scale parallel processing tasks. The absence of a discrete GPU limits its applicability for large-scale deep learning training, but its strong vector instruction support (including AVX-512) makes it capable for CPU-based inference and general-purpose enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is an x86_64 general-purpose server from the Fadsv7 family, featuring 32 dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 physical cores running at 4.5 GHz. It is configured with 128.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core) and 3780 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, this server delivers top-tier single-core performance and database operations, alongside strong multi-core capabilities and memory bandwidth. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration. Qualitatively, the server offers high resource density by bundling significant local storage with dedicated high-frequency compute resources, avoiding external storage overheads. This configuration is suited for database management systems, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
